profile.name: Asad Ijaz
profile.role: Data scientist and automation developer, Faisalabad, Pakistan
profile.tagline: I build predictive models and the software that puts them to work.
profile.summary: Asad Ijaz is a data scientist building machine learning models, LLM agents and RAG systems in Python.
about: I take a problem from raw data to something people can use: cleaning and exploring the data, training the model (churn prediction, recommendation systems), then wrapping it in an app or pipeline.

Lately that work is agentic. I build LangGraph systems that retrieve, grade their own answers and correct course, a voice assistant that works in Urdu and English with 35 tools, and pipelines that research, write and publish on their own.
I am a data scientist at Optimum Tech and a computer science student at the University of Agriculture, Faisalabad. I also take freelance work: ML models, RAG chatbots, data pipelines and automation.

projects.title: Telecom customer churn prediction
projects.summary: An end-to-end churn pipeline: SQL data normalization, exploratory analysis, model training in Python and an interactive Streamlit app that ranks at-risk customers.

projects.title: Agentic RAG with hybrid search and reranking
projects.summary: A LangGraph agent that routes each question, retrieves with dense plus BM25 search, reranks with a cross-encoder, grades what it found and corrects itself when the answer is weak.

projects.title: JARVIS voice assistant
projects.summary: An Urdu and English voice assistant behind a wake word and PIN, driven by a LangGraph agent with 35 tools and RAG over local files.

projects.title: Aura Accessories shopping assistant
projects.summary: An agentic RAG chatbot for a luxury fashion brand, built as a LangGraph ReAct agent running on Groq.

projects.title: AI email dispatcher
projects.summary: A Streamlit app where a Gemini-powered LangGraph workflow writes, themes, illustrates and sends personalised bulk email.

projects.title: Autonomous LinkedIn publisher
projects.summary: A multi-agent pipeline that finds a trending data science topic, researches it, writes a post, fact-checks it and publishes it to LinkedIn.

projects.title: University timetable management system
projects.summary: A Flask and MySQL web app for scheduling university classes, with Admin, Teacher and Student roles, a 7-table schema and automatic clash detection.

projects.title: Deep learning projects
projects.summary: Six TensorFlow/Keras projects in one repo: MNIST with an ANN and a CNN, CIFAR-10, Cats vs Dogs with transfer learning, a tuned California Housing ANN and an LSTM next-word predictor trained on Kafka's The Metamorphosis.

projects.title: Classical machine learning projects
projects.summary: Four scikit-learn projects in one repo: a heart disease classifier, insurance cost regression with random forests, an end-to-end housing price pipeline and a movie recommender.
